question: The Nuakhai festival is mainly seen in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Nuakhai festival is mainly celebrated in Odisha**
 
• The** Nuakhai festival is mainly celebrated in Western Odisha** and Southern Chhattisgarh.
 
• It's **also celebrated in the neighbouring areas of Simdega in Jharkhand. **
 
• Nuakhai is** a harvest festival **that welcomes the new rice of the season.
 
• It's also known as Nabanna. 
 
• The **festival includes nine sets of rituals, followed by the actual day of celebration.**
 
• The day ends with dances, dramas, and folk songs. People also share gifts with loved ones and seek blessings from elders. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Himachal Pradesh**

 
 
• The** Halda Festival **is a major New Year's celebration in the Lahaul region of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It** features exotic drinks, dance performances, family reunions, and cultural celebrations**.
 
• **Other festivals** in Himachal Pradesh include Chaitraul Festival and Doongri Festival.
 
• Kullu Dussehra is another significant festival in Himachal Pradesh, which is celebrated with a grand fair in the Kullu valley. 
 
 
 
• **Haryana**
 
 
• **Teej** is a famous festival in Haryana that is celebrated on the third day of the Shrawana month.
 
• The festival is celebrated with swings in gardens and girls applying henna on their hands. 
 
 
 
• **Odisha**
 
 
• Durga Puja is the most important festival in Odisha and is celebrated in the month of Ashwin or Kartik. The streets are lit up and pandals are decorated to celebrate the festival. 
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**
 
 
• Some of the main festivals in Rajasthan include Bundi Utsav, Desert festival, Gangaur Festival, Matasya festival, Braj festival, and Shekhawati festival
